description: Source code for ATM driver core functions for the AR9 chipset, including hardware initialization, firmware management, and register configuration.

methods.name: ar9_fw_ver
methods.description: Retrieves the firmware version (major and minor) for the AR9 device.

methods.name: ar9_init
methods.description: Initializes the AR9 ATM hardware, including power management, reset, and buffer setup.

methods.name: ar9_shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the AR9 ATM hardware by disabling power modules.

methods.name: ar9_start
methods.description: Starts the firmware download and restarts the AR9 device.

methods.name: ar9_stop
methods.description: Stops the AR9 device by halting firmware execution.
